slot.instructions: Choose the slot containing the piece to extract. Use its current position, not its destination.

extraction.instructions: The selected slot must be opened. Choose the direction that does NOT send the target partner down into this slot. Compare partnerPosition to the incoming position described in each option. If the partner is already in its own bottom/middle home, either direction is safe. If both are safe, either is acceptable.

criteria.R-forward: This direction puts the corner from URB into DBR. Choose only if partnerPosition is NOT URB.
criteria.R-reverse: This direction puts the corner from UFR into DBR. Choose only if partnerPosition is NOT UFR.
